title: Kusanagi Nene — Celebrate With Fireworks〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Nene's Room

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Another exhausting day...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I do feel less tired than I used to, so I guess I've managed to build up some stamina.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I'm glad that decided to start running every few days.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Still, I wasn't expecting to pay homage to the Little Mermaid like this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'm really looking forward to how our show turns out.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And we're really ambassadors now…

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: Phoenix Ocean Resort has an open-air Beach Stage that already attracts a lot of visitors due to it being a sort of public amphitheater.

rows.Speaker: Keisuke
rows.Line: We would like you to put on a show that is not only family friendly, like the ones you are already doing, but also appeals to a wider audience.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I was expecting our first assignment to be a much more modest affair...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Us being ambassadors sort of means that we're representing all of Phoenix Wonderland's stages and troupes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So how the shows we do outside of the park go will directly affect how the shows back home will do.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I hope this goes well... It has to...)

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I just couldn't give up!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I want Phoenix Wonderland to be a place that makes everyone smile forever and ever!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I don't care if you replace all the rides and get rid of the stages...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I just don't want it to stop being a place where everyone can smile, laugh and be happy!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We somehow managed to tell Emu's family how we really felt about the future of the park.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (And I don't want things to end there.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I want more people to visit Phoenix Wonderland, and in order to do that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: We have to do everything we can as ambassadors to make that happen.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm also the one who suggested that we choose the Little Mermaid, so I should start working out the details.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Where do I begin…?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, I know. I can start by rewatching the theatrical version.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I've already seen it enough times to recite most of the lines from memory, but it still might be able to give me some new ideas.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Let's see... Aha, there you are!
Pop in the DVD and... Play.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Wow, it still holds up!
She really knows how to draw you into the story too.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (No, what am I doing...?! I have to come up with some ideas for our show.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, the lighting for this scene's gorgeous. It's like the stage is really just beneath the waves along the shore.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We'll be performing outside, so this might not be possible...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But we could try doing something with the backdrop instead...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Phew...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I've been watching this since I was little, but I still keep discovering new things about it.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (But I'm looking at it from a production standpoint, so I guess that's natural.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Anyway, let's see what I've got...

rows.Speaker: Interviewer
rows.Line: <And here we have the star of tonight's show, Yuka Kazamatsuri.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Oh, right. The bonus footage for this DVD includes interviews. I guess they're just set to play automatically.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (It's been a while, so I think I'll watch them.)

rows.Speaker: Interviewer
rows.Line: <I understand that this was your first time playing the lead role. Were you nervous at all?>

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: <Of course I was nervous. I'm a no-name actress who somehow landed the lead for this show.>

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: <But as long as this stage stands and I'm allowed to play this role...>

rows.Speaker: Yuka
rows.Line: <I'll be here to give the best performances that I can.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: That's so cool...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Even when she's under all that pressure, she stays in character and never loses focus...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I need to keep trying my best too!
